fictionalNotice: All names and genre/language assignments are invented for prototype use. Coincidental resemblance to actual artists is possible; no identity/trademark clearance has been performed. This is not a researched directory or measurement of Singapore genre prevalence.
distributionRationale: Editorial prototype weighting: guitar and pop scenes lead, electronic and heavier scenes have substantial coverage, and every family and all four approved child specimens are represented. Counts are design choices, not observed statistics.

sharedAudienceModel.meaning: Each edge is an undirected fictional audience intersection over the same unspecified demo period. Pair counts may overlap; do not sum them as unique listeners. These are not follows, collaborations, recommendations, or verified listening statistics.
sharedAudienceModel.note: Artist audience totals remain null. Pair counts are not derived from a simulated listener population and must not be treated as one.
sharedAudienceModel.selectionMethod: Seeded distance-weighted thinning of pairs eligible from either endpoint: at least one endpoint ranks the other among its nearest two map dots. Explicitly enforce one or two links for every artist, with at least 40% having two. Retry if capping incoming choices would isolate an artist. No genre quota, global-connectivity requirement, or position changes. Counts remain fictional fixtures.
